Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: premium Korean fantasy game standalone equipment weapon resource, in the same polished engraved-metal rendering family as the existing Eastern Arms Merchant (동방무기상) gold weapon. Input image 1 is the ONLY target gun: retain its recognizable overall construction, proportions, attachments, viewing side and orientation. When image 2 is supplied, it is ONLY a reference for craftsmanship, engraved metal, clear silhouette and quality; DO NOT copy its dragon head, gun shape, red color or ornaments.
Output exactly ONE complete isolated gun, horizontal near-orthographic side profile, large and centered in a landscape image with safe transparent margins around every part. High-resolution finely painted semi-real 2D game equipment art, refined metal reflections and precise bevels, not a blurry screenshot, not heavy worn grunge. Genuine transparent RGBA background including interior openings; do not draw a checkerboard, shadow plane, scenery, dark rectangle, frame, card, labels, logos or watermark.
CRITICAL GEOMETRY: treat the whole gun as one rigid object. Lock one perfectly straight receiver-to-barrel-to-muzzle axis; upper/lower barrel edges, top rail and sight axes retain coherent straight/parallel alignment and perspective. No drooping, kinks at the front of receiver, curved barrel, warped stock or disconnected parts. Keep the entire stock, muzzle, magazine and decorations in frame, no cropping.
Target is user gun 1: compact P90-like bullpup, muzzle pointing LEFT, long boxy top receiver and two flip-up sights, short forward barrel, large rounded trigger/grip openings, bow and central five-point star over rear body, restrained hanging charm, circular rear chamber containing a tiny bear-shaped ornament. Preserve this exact silhouette and the special bow, star and bear identity.
Recolor the pink and white body into a luxurious two-metal design: majority rich champagne gold and warm 18k gold on main armor and engraved bands, substantial polished platinum-silver planes, satin silver on secondary panels and alternating edge inlays, small charcoal grip/inner mechanism accents for depth. The bow is champagne-gold silk with silver edging; star is a gold-edged pearl-silver jewel; bear/chamber becomes warm ivory-gold translucent light, not pink. Subtle elegant floral/cloud engraving following the existing surfaces, no extra oversized sculpture. Every important surface should read precious metal with distinct gold/silver separation, never flat yellow paint. Only faint local warm light contained within the chamber. No floating unrelated particles. Remove the original screenshot background and all existing letter-like markings.
